summary: This Form 6-K filing by NexGen Energy Ltd., a Canadian mining issuer, contains only routine quarterly financial statements (unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements) and MD&A for the period ended March 31, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing discloses a net loss of C$156M driven primarily by mark-to-market losses on convertible debentures, exploration expenditures, and an impairment of an associate investment. There are no announced corporate transactions, strategic alternatives, tender offers, or management changes. As a foreign private issuer's routine periodic report, this does not constitute a special-situations event.
